name: My Darling Dark Elf
source:
Nienke is a dark elf who lives in the small, sleepy village of Alpenrose. Though beautiful, Alpenrose is secluded, and it boasts exactly one family of dark elves: Nienke's. Nienke was singled out and teased for most of her childhood owing to her unusual appearance, and it doesn't help that a nasty childhood illness left her shorter and slighter than the rest of her peers.

Nienke was always an outcast, but she never minded it - or, at least, she tried not to. She had her best friend Cornelia, and she wasn't lonely...

Until Cornelia leaves Alpenrose to attend university, leaving Nienke behind.

Nienke would love to attend university herself, but her overprotective parents don't want to let her stray too far afield owing to her delicate health. Nienke has to stay at home instead, where her parents can keep an eye on her, and help out at her parents' café, Fleur de Lys.

Nienke is already twenty, but her parents still treat her like a child. Her every day is the same, and she's bored of the daily grind...

Until a fellow dark elf called Merel pays Nienke a visit. She claims to be Nienke's childhood friend, though Nienke can't remember her. Did she really used to play with a girl as aggressively cheerful and energetic as Merel...

And why is Merel so freaking tall, anyway?! 

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4099120/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
尼恩克是一个黑暗精灵，住在阿尔彭罗斯这个昏昏欲睡的小村庄里。尽管美丽，但阿尔本罗斯却很僻静，它拥有一个黑暗精灵家族：尼恩克家族。由于她不寻常的外表，尼恩克在她童年的大部分时间里都被孤立和嘲笑，更糟糕的是，童年时期的一场严重疾病让她比其他同龄人更矮、更瘦。

尼恩克一直是个被遗弃的人，但她从不介意——或者，至少，她试图不介意。她有她最好的朋友科妮莉亚，她并不孤单……

直到科妮莉亚离开阿尔彭罗斯去上大学，留下尼恩克。

尼恩克很想自己上大学，但她过度保护的父母不想让她因为她脆弱的健康状况而走得太远。妮恩克必须呆在家里，这样她的父母可以照顾她，并在她父母的百合花咖啡馆帮忙。

妮恩克已经二十岁了，但她的父母仍然像对待孩子一样对待她。她的每一天都是一样的，她厌倦了日常的琐事……

直到一位名叫梅雷尔的黑暗精灵同伴来拜访尼恩克。她自称是尼恩克儿时的朋友，但尼恩克不记得她了。她以前真的和梅雷尔这样积极开朗、精力充沛的女孩一起玩过吗……

无论如何，为什么梅雷尔这么高？！

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4099120/]Steam[/url]]
